fields.System.Title: INB-212 — Reject stock with insufficient shelf life
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want stock arriving too close to its expiry to be refused or
quarantined, so that we do not accept goods we cannot sell.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product with a minimum shelf life on receipt, when stock arrives with less
  • remaining, then the line is flagged and cannot be received as available.
  • - Given the flag, then the clerk can refuse the goods or receive them into quarantine
  • with supervisor approval.
  • - Given quarantined short-life stock, then a discrepancy is recorded against the
  • supplier.
  • - Given the shelf life rule, then it is expressed as a proportion of total shelf life or
  • an absolute number of days, whichever the product specifies.
